INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
DATABASE_CORRUPTED: The accounting database may be damaged. Restore from a backup if you have one.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
INVALID_PHOTO: The selected photo is not a valid JPEG, PNG, or WebP image.
INVALID_TRANSACTION_TYPE: Transaction type must be Cash In or Cash Out.
INVALID_PAGE_SIZE: Enter a page size between 5 and 100.
CURRENCY_CODE_INVALID: Currency code must be 3 to 5 letters.
LAST_ACTIVE_CURRENCY: At least one active currency is required.
CURRENCY_IN_USE: This currency has historical transactions, so it cannot be permanently deleted. Deactivate it instead.
DENOMINATION_EXISTS: That denomination already exists for this currency.
DENOMINATION_VALUE_INVALID: Enter a denomination value greater than zero.
DENOMINATION_IN_USE: This denomination has history and cannot be permanently deleted. Deactivate it instead.
PHOTO_TOO_LARGE: The photo must be 5 MB or smaller.
PHOTO_NOT_FOUND: The profile photo could not be loaded.
FONT_MISSING: Required report fonts are missing. Restore the bundled font files and try again.
INVALID_DATE_RANGE: The end date must be on or after the start date.
DATE_RANGE_REQUIRED: Enter a start date and an end date.
IMPORT_FAILED: Import failed. No data was changed.
INVALID_BACKUP: This backup file is not valid.
BACKUP_VERSION_MISMATCH: This backup is not compatible with the current application version.
RESTORE_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Confirm that you understand current data will be replaced.
BACKUP_WRITE_FAILED: Could not write the backup file.
RESTORE_FAILED: Restore failed. Current data was left unchanged.
RECOVERY_NOT_CONFIGURED: A security hint is not configured.
RECOVERY_INVALID: Enter a valid security question and answer.
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: The source customer does not have enough balance for this transfer.
TRANSFER_SAME_CUSTOMER: Choose two different customers for a transfer.
INVALID_COLOR: Enter a valid hex color such as #1f7a4d.
PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Password must be at least 8 characters.
PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: Password must be 128 characters or fewer.
PASSWORD_MISMATCH: New password and confirmation do not match.
PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: New password must be different from the current password.
TRANSFER_IMMUTABLE: Transfer records cannot be edited. Delete the transfer instead.
UPDATE_UNSUPPORTED: Updates are not available in this environment.
UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: Could not check for updates. You can keep using FMT offline.
UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Download failed. Your current installation was not changed.
UPDATE_NOT_AVAILABLE: No update is available to download.
UPDATE_BACKUP_FAILED: Update was not installed because the safety backup could not be completed.
UPDATE_INVALID_VERSION: The update server returned an invalid version.
TELLER_SESSION_REQUIRED: Open a teller session before recording cash.
TELLER_SESSION_ALREADY_OPEN: A teller session is already open.
TELLER_SESSION_CLOSED: This teller session is already closed.
TELLER_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The entered amount does not match the denomination total.
TELLER_INSUFFICIENT_CASH: There is not enough physical cash of the selected denominations.
TELLER_OPENING_MISMATCH: Opening cash must match the current till count.
NON_INTEGER_QUANTITY: Denomination quantities must be whole numbers.
